dawn.sky: soft periwinkle and lavender-blue dawn; restrained peach-ivory horizon
dawn.clouds: peach, ivory and pale lavender with soft blue shadows

day.sky: milky powder blue; pale blue-ivory near the snowy horizon
day.clouds: soft ivory-white highlights with pale lavender-blue shadows

dusk.sky: muted lavender and mauve; soft apricot and peach-gold horizon
dusk.clouds: apricot, blush and ivory with mauve and violet shadows

night.sky: rich gentle indigo-to-navy night; preserve restrained fixed stars
night.clouds: muted indigo, navy and lavender-blue; exclude all stars

sky_prompt: Remove every cloud from the supplied cozy clear-winter plate and reconstruct the time-specific pastel sky gradient. Preserve the exact snowy landscape, composition, lighting, matte gouache style and 16:9 framing. At night preserve the fixed star field. No precipitation, new objects or text.
cloud_prompt: Extract only the open-sky fair-weather clouds from the supplied clear-winter plate onto genuine RGBA transparency. Preserve their exact time-specific color, scale, position and soft painterly edges. Remove every landscape element and exclude stars, precipitation, lightning, sun, moon, text and rectangular haze.
